claim: Eight CODE V systems completed the v2 replacement comparison budget
exact_support: 8/8 pass; traditional and nested choices recorded; restore_ok=true
limitation: Bounded CODE V library cohort; not a manufacturing population

claim: Nested and traditional decisions differed for gaosi and oradbg01 at 50 cycles/mm
limitation: Choice difference is frequency- and perturbation-set dependent
Frequencies are secondary analyses, not independent samples

claim: Decision effect has a perturbation-amplitude threshold in this bounded study
oradbg01 disagreement is reproducible under a frozen random perturbation set
limitation: gaosi regular-grid disagreement did not reproduce

claim: The MTF score parser agrees with an independent implementation
limitation: Independent parser uses same raw native text and fixed frequency token

claim: maksutov was excluded under a documented failure gate and replaced by oradbg01
exact_support: Maksutov TGR/clear-aperture failure; oradbg01 perturbation/restore pass
limitation: Replacement is an amendment, not a hidden deletion

claim: Three of five additional library systems passed the held-out qualification and two failures were retained
exact_support: tessar, petzval, and wideang pass; eyepiece and microscp fail on RDY S1=1e18 sentinel
limitation: Held-out set is still a curated library subset; failures are not replaced

claim: The three passing held-outs selected the same candidate under nominal, mean, fifth-percentile, and minimum scores
exact_support: tessar 2, petzval 1, wideang 3 under all four summaries; 20 two-variable perturbations per candidate
limitation: Fixed perturbation design; no claim of universal multivariable invariance

claim: A representative Zemax audit reproduced the sorting procedure on two sample families
exact_support: Tessar nominal/nested 2/2; Petzval nominal/nested 3/3; standalone bridge probe valid
limitation: Representative samples are not identical CODE V prescriptions; not cross-engine equivalence

claim: Physical/manufactured validation is not yet supported
exact_support: No measured/as-built input was present; no physical result claimed
limitation: Requires user-provided raw MTF, as-built prescription, calibration metadata, and checksum

claim: A fixed-seed Monte Carlo extension preserved the held-out selections
exact_support: 600 Monte Carlo bundles plus 60 nominal controls; tessar 2, petzval 1, wideang 3 under nominal/mean/q05/minimum
limitation: Uniform perturbation distribution and 50 draws per candidate are registered computational assumptions

claim: Public real-MTF sources were located and analyzed without being merged into the CODE V cohort
exact_support: Vendor reports contain measured real-lens MTF curves; public workbook contains eight measured IOL sheets with peak MTF 0.221--0.790
limitation: No source provides prescription-linked imaging-lens candidates for direct reranking

claim: The public measured workbook shows model- and pupil-dependent MTF heterogeneity
exact_support: 20% MTF through-focus widths 0.336--3.554 D across eight sheets
limitation: IOL through-focus data are an external benchmark, not an imaging-lens validation
